text.text: A communal gathering space designed to encourage social interaction, public activities and community events.
A shared public space that supports recreation, social interaction and everyday activities for people of all ages.
Every space is a short walk from the homes. The central plaza and the Ruhgandu give people places to gather, the park gives shade and play, and green corridors link them to the waterfront.
Workspaces integrated into the public realm to promote a balance between professional activities and community life.
A green recreational space that enhances residents’ well-being while providing opportunities for relaxation and community engagement.
